name: Waterfront buildings, Hong Kong
dimensions: Height 22.1 cm; Width 31.3 cm; Height 5.25 in; Width 12.25 in
summary: A view looking westwards along the north shore of Hong Kong Island, with the waterfront premises of Lindsay & Co. and Dent & Co., and Dent's Pier. Small craft are seen in the shallow water, and a Chinese figure sits on the steep hillside on the left.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
